purpose: Define LuHm naming namespaces and a person-centered degradation path that compresses names without losing recoverable meaning.
primeLaw: human meaning first; compression is an alias layer, never the only surviving identity

kebabCase.use: repository/transport slugs, branch/file instance names, route/package names, and fields whose contract selects the kebab namespace

dragonTail.use: status, state, sentinel, gate, receipt-state, debug-verb, and fields whose contract selects the dragonTail namespace

camelHump.law: starts lowercase; later semantic word humps may capitalize
camelHump.use: person-centered canonical machine identifiers, JSON keys, object properties, agent ids, handlers, and code names

canonicalHumanLayer.rule: start from the fullest concise human-centered object or action meaning

vowelRippedLayer.rule: optional compression alias; preserve word boundaries and first letters, remove non-leading vowels where doing so remains recognizable

shorthandLayer.rule: final compact alias; lowercase alphanumeric only; must be explicitly registered and must not be guessed from an ambiguous name

repositoryKebabNamespace.purpose: unify repository naming and provide a drift-protection boundary

namespaceEscalation.identityLaw: all layers resolve to one canonical human-centered identity; compression and formatting do not change target, authority, or execution
namespaceEscalation.executionLaw: names and aliases resolve identity only; workflow execution requires its separately defined explicit intent/trigger
